description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing lessons within an educational platform. It includes route handlers for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting lessons, along with associated Swagger documentation annotations.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list lessons with optional filtering and pagination. Requires authentication.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new lesson. Requires authentication. Currently not implemented.

methods.name: router.get('/by-course/:courseId')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list lessons belonging to a specific course. Requires authentication.

methods.name: router.get('/:lessonId')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific lesson by its ID. Requires authentication. Currently not implemented.

methods.name: router.patch('/:lessonId')
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update a lesson by its ID. Requires authentication. Currently not implemented.

methods.name: router.delete('/:lessonId')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a lesson by its ID. Requires authentication. Currently not implemented.
